segmentos.texto: At two in the morning, at a truck stop off a detour, the same couple walked into the diner twice. Same words. Same rain on their jackets.
What I found on my dashcam the next morning still doesn't make sense. The full story is on The Quiet Hours.

estilo: Cinematic still photograph, vertical 9:16 composition, 35mm film, night, muted desaturated colors, low contrast, cold tones with warm diner light, subtle film grain, realistic, no readable text, no logos, no watermark.

planos.prompt: An old truck stop diner glowing alone at night in the rain, a neon sign with letters burned out, wet empty parking lot.
Extreme close up of a small brass bell above a diner's glass door, swinging as the door opens, rain on the glass, night.
A young couple seen from behind walking down a diner aisle at night, a gray hoodie and a thin denim jacket, both jackets dark with rain on the shoulders, faces not visible.
An empty diner booth wiped perfectly clean under warm light, no glasses, no menus, nothing on the table, vinyl seats, rain on the window.
A middle-aged waitress seen from behind carrying two menus and two glasses of water toward a booth where a young couple sits, warm diner light.
Extreme close up of an old cheap digital watch on a young man's wrist resting on a diner table, the display glowing, rain-darkened sleeve, warm light.
A cheap dashcam mounted on a car windshield at dawn, its tiny screen glowing with grainy footage of an old station wagon, gray morning light.

efeitos.frase: the bell over the front door rang
